name: ship-tasks
description: Deliver selected Task Manager work with durable acceptance reporting and problem-first strategic explanations.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver work with visible acceptance incidents.
interface.longDescription: Includes two sibling skills. Ship Tasks delivers work through explicit $ship-tasks or natural language that names an existing Task or selected Task Manager scope. A delivery verb alone does not activate it. Its requirements act as a constitution: sufficient evidence, truthful state, readable native comments, visible acceptance incidents, and authority boundaries are mandatory while planning, tools, diagnostics, and acceptance methods remain agent choices. An ordinary To Do to In Progress transition creates no comment. Every comment Ship Tasks publishes first passes a separate independent Strategic Explainer; the main agent verifies the facts but cannot substitute its own rewrite. Strategic Explainer does not take status, authority, or execution decisions.
defaultPrompt: Deliver TM-123 to a verified terminal outcome
Create exactly one Task in Task Manager and immediately start delivering it
Use Strategic Explainer with an explicit problem to find strategic context and explain the current result
